## Change

Describe the issue and the smallest behavior or documentation change.

## Review

- [ ] Linked issue or agreed discussion/spec.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] `cd app && npm test` and `npm run check` pass, or skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] Safety, evidence, and accessibility limits are clear.
- [ ] No real user, participant, contact, device, or operator data is included.
- [ ] New assets and dependencies have source/license notes.
- [ ] Animal health/behavior, scoring, privacy, retention, camera, or safety changes have maintainer review requested.
